title: Form 8-K - Home BancShares, Inc. (April 16, 2026 Annual Shareholder Meeting Results)
summary: Home BancShares, Inc. (HOMB) filed an 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on April 16, 2026. All fourteen director nominees were elected, executive compensation was approved in an advisory vote, and the appointment of Forvis Mazars LLP as independent auditor for fiscal year 2026 was ratified. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: All 14 director candidates were elected with votes ranging from 135.3M to 147.0M for; no withhold votes exceeded 12.3M
Advisory vote on executive compensation passed with 141.2M votes for (95.6%) vs 6.1M against
Auditor ratification: 172.5M votes for, 1.6M against, 160K abstentions; zero broker non-votes
Total shares voted: approximately 174.2M, with 26.5M broker non-votes on director and compensation votes
Jennifer C. Floyd, Chief Accounting Officer, signed the filing on behalf of the company dated April 17, 2026
